verdict: No scientific blocker in the actual source, independent reference or bounded evidence. This is not final task approval; the provisional harmonic range and calibration design must be reconciled before packaging.
scope: Read all seven frozen author files and raw report rows, verified hashes and recomputed report summaries only. Read the three closest archived AUTHOR records and selected primary-source sections. No scientific/model/Docker run or author edit.

physics.apparatus: The prescribed smooth periodic incompressible field, positive molecular diffusivity, uniform initial phase and unwrapped laboratory displacement define the long-time tensor without walls, conditioning or an extra fluid problem. The known units and period are sufficient.
physics.completed_closure: A Brownian auxiliary phase with covariance rate 2 diag(Kx,Ky) samples all velocity harmonics. Its integrated velocity plus independent bare Brownian displacement has Kx=D+(a^2+c^2/4)/(2Ky), Ky=D+(b^2+d^2/4)/(2Kx). The implemented positive quadratic root solves these equations and gives Kx,Ky>=D. It is a coherent self-consistent Gaussian sampling model; it does not preserve actual advected phase trajectories or their streamline memory.
physics.calibration: In either one-leg shear the actual transverse coordinate is molecular Brownian motion, giving the same long-time diffusion coefficients as the source. Independent auxiliary/output noises do not make their full tracer paths identical. Two different shear strengths identify D globally through the difference (C2-C1)/D, avoiding the two-valued inverse of one D+C/D reading.
physics.spectral_oracle: The code constructs the backward generator D Delta+u dot grad, solves its mean-zero correctors and symmetrizes <u_i chi_j>. The independent energy identity D I+D<grad chi_i dot grad chi_j> has the correct normalization and positivity. Fourier mode signs and all first/second harmonics are included.
physics.reference: The independent periodic spatial jump generator has rates D/h^2 +/- u_i/(2h) and signed displacement marks across wraps. Its stationary counting-moment equations, tilted-generator second derivative and finite-time moment propagation use the correct factor of two. Uniform stationarity follows from each velocity component being independent of its own coordinate. Positive rates are established only for the grids and controls actually checked; the continuum comparison is a refinement result.

existing_evidence.preservation: Every original field, physical prediction and initial source result appears unchanged in the followup. Weak and signed underprediction outcomes are retained; 21 original refined-source rows have an underprediction in at least one axis.
existing_evidence.report_integrity: All JSON numeric values are finite. Raw row counts, copied original predictions, relative differences and minimum strong gap match their summaries. All 16 archive/inventory hashes match.

required_package_followups: The provisional c,d range is [-.7,.7], but the amplitude3 shear calibration uses second harmonic .75. Six followup anchor rows exceed that proposed range. Preserve these results; explicitly resolve the future public range/calibration (for example validate an enlarged range or choose in-range calibration) before task freeze.

The 168-case refined sweep uses the already checked spectral solver; only 12 physical cases have independent spatial-reference comparisons, with five finer-grid checks. Do not describe all followup points as independently validated.

The 11.54% A5-to8 minimum and 4.50% A4 minimum are sampled gaps, not uniform box bounds. The full signed-amplitude/interior domain, new scored cases, reference refinement and fixed-noise calibration must be checked in a future harness.

No calibration file, instrument sigma, 256-noise study, task grader, local controls or measured model difficulty exists yet. No actual Lagrangian feedback or general upper-bound claim should be attributed to the refined source.

If a future solver selects the correct advected generator but fails through Fourier signs, grid positivity or convergence, classify that separately from retention of the Gaussian sampling approximation.

overlap.assessment: Related tracer homogenization and memory themes are acknowledged. Tube dispersion omitted all shear enhancement, driven diffusion used an equilibrium response relation, and survivor transport changed the path-selection ensemble. This source retains exact nonzero shear diffusion and replaces cell-scale advected sampling by a self-consistent Gaussian phase. No exact duplicate found in the disclosed comparison; this is not a claim of a wholly unrelated mathematical principle.

primary_access.title: Majda and Kramer, Simplified models for turbulent diffusion, Physics Reports 314 (1999)
primary_access.read_scope: Selected PDF pages 10-13 (Sec.2.1.2, equations13-16 and nearby derivation) and pages33-35 (Sec.2.2.3 cellular-flow discussion), plus introductory SDE. Not the full337-page article.
primary_access.support: Supports periodic tracer homogenization, positive enhanced diffusion and sensitivity to streamline geometry. The particular Gaussian fixed-point closure is justified by the auxiliary-process construction, not claimed to be an exact formula from this paper.
